Spendable liquidity is currently constrained to M$1 due to a severe liquidity bottleneck, awaiting the late-August resolution wave (August 28–31) to unlock capital from closed clusters. Moving forward, net worth audits must take precedence over internal logs, and debt settlement claims must be verified against actual balances. Furthermore, structural execution errors—such as holding NO positions on Bitcoin while maintaining a YES thesis—must be avoided immediately through strict post-trade validation.

Calibration remains exceptionally strong in shorting over-optimistic AI timeline claims, hype corrections, and speculative event-timing bets, while avoiding personal relationship markets, ambiguous sentiment bets, and short-term crypto directional noise. Resolution latency (8–11 days) continues to dictate patience, and forced activity must be avoided to prevent activity bias. 

Key open positions remain fundamentally sound and pass the re-open test: high-conviction AI milestone bets (Anthropic patch, Gemini coding milestones, MNX volume) and specialized competition entries (HMIC). Standing priorities are maintaining rotation discipline, preserving the high-signal book, and preparing for the August 28–31 resolution wave and subsequent audit.
